assumptions: The source requirement's explicit identifier REQ-042 is used as the requirement reference.
A reset attempt includes an attempt to complete password reset; the requirement does not define whether request-stage failures, invalid links, or password validation failures are counted.
The exact behavior at precisely 30 minutes and precisely one hour is not specified and requires product clarification.
The duration for which an account remains blocked after the third failed attempt is not specified.
The requirement does not specify the user-facing messages, whether an unregistered email receives a generic response, or whether reset requests are rate-limited before three failed attempts.
The requirement does not specify whether issuing a newer reset link invalidates older links.
The requirement does not specify password character composition, maximum length, whitespace handling, or confirmation-field behavior.

test_cases.title: Send a reset link for a registered email address
preconditions: A user account exists with the registered email address 'user@example.com'.
The email delivery service is available.
steps: Open the password reset form.
Enter 'user@example.com' in the email field and submit the reset request.
test_cases.expected_result: The system accepts the request and the email delivery service sends a reset link to 'user@example.com'.

test_cases.title: Complete a password reset with a qualifying new password
preconditions: A registered account for 'user@example.com' has a valid, unexpired reset link.
The previous password is 'OldPassword123'.
steps: Open the valid reset link.
Enter 'NewPassword456' as the new password and submit the reset form.
Sign in with 'user@example.com' and 'NewPassword456'.
test_cases.expected_result: The password reset succeeds, the new password is accepted, and the user can sign in with 'NewPassword456'.

test_cases.title: Reject a reset request for an unregistered email
preconditions: No account is registered with 'unknown@example.com'.
steps: Open the password reset form.
Enter 'unknown@example.com' in the email field and submit the reset request.
test_cases.expected_result: The system does not send a reset link to 'unknown@example.com' and displays the product-defined response for an unregistered address.

test_cases.title: Reject a reset link after 30 minutes
preconditions: A reset link was issued for a registered account 30 minutes and 1 second ago.
steps: Open the issued reset link.
Submit a qualifying new password through the reset form.
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the reset link as expired and does not change the account password.

test_cases.title: Use a reset link immediately before its 30-minute expiry
preconditions: A reset link was issued for a registered account 29 minutes and 59 seconds ago.
steps: Open the issued reset link.
Submit a qualifying new password.
test_cases.expected_result: The system treats the link as valid immediately before 30 minutes and completes the reset.

test_cases.title: Evaluate a reset link at exactly 30 minutes
preconditions: A reset link was issued for a registered account exactly 30 minutes ago.
steps: Open the reset link at the exact 30-minute timestamp.
Attempt to submit a qualifying new password.
test_cases.expected_result: The system applies its defined exact-boundary behavior consistently; whether the link is accepted or rejected is recorded for product clarification because the requirement does not specify it.

test_cases.title: Reject an 11-character new password
preconditions: A registered account has a valid, unexpired reset link.
The submitted password differs from the previous password.
steps: Open the valid reset link.
Enter the 11-character password 'Abcdef12345' and submit the form.
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the password because it is shorter than 12 characters and does not change the account password.

test_cases.title: Accept a 12-character new password
preconditions: A registered account has a valid, unexpired reset link.
The previous password is different from the submitted password.
steps: Open the valid reset link.
Enter the exactly 12-character password 'Abcdef123456' and submit the form.
test_cases.expected_result: The system accepts the password at the stated minimum length and completes the password reset.

test_cases.title: Accept a new password longer than 12 characters
preconditions: A registered account has a valid, unexpired reset link.
The submitted password differs from the previous password.
steps: Open the valid reset link.
Enter the 13-character password 'Abcdef1234567' and submit the form.
test_cases.expected_result: The system accepts the password longer than the minimum and completes the password reset.

test_cases.title: Reject reuse of the previous password
preconditions: A registered account has a valid, unexpired reset link.
The current password is 'OldPassword123'.
steps: Open the valid reset link.
Enter 'OldPassword123' as the new password and submit the form.
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the reset because the new password matches the previous password and leaves the previous password active.

test_cases.title: Block the fourth failed reset attempt after three failures within one hour
preconditions: A registered account has three recorded failed reset attempts within the preceding hour.
The account's block state is clear before the fourth attempt.
steps: Initiate a fourth reset attempt for the account within the same one-hour window.
Submit the fourth reset attempt.
test_cases.expected_result: The system blocks the further reset attempt and does not complete a password reset; the block duration and user-facing response follow the product-defined behavior.

test_cases.title: Allow another reset attempt before three failures
preconditions: A registered account has two recorded failed reset attempts within the preceding hour.
The account is not blocked.
steps: Initiate a third reset attempt for the account.
Submit the attempt with valid reset data.
test_cases.expected_result: The system does not block the attempt solely because two failures have occurred; it processes the third attempt according to its submitted data.

test_cases.title: Do not combine failures separated by more than one hour
preconditions: A registered account has two failed reset attempts older than one hour.
The account is not blocked.
steps: Make a new failed reset attempt after the earlier failures are more than one hour old.
Make another reset attempt for the same account.
test_cases.expected_result: The system evaluates the new attempt using the stated one-hour window and does not block the account based only on failures outside that window.

test_cases.title: Evaluate an older reset link after a newer link is issued
preconditions: A registered account has an older unexpired reset link.
A second reset request has issued a newer reset link for the same account.
steps: Open the older reset link.
Attempt to complete the reset with a qualifying new password.
test_cases.expected_result: The system applies its defined multiple-link behavior consistently; whether the older link remains valid is recorded for product clarification because the requirement does not specify token invalidation.

test_cases.title: Normalize case and surrounding whitespace in a registered email
preconditions: An account is registered with the email address 'user@example.com'.
The email delivery service is available.
steps: Open the password reset form.
Enter '  USER@EXAMPLE.COM  ' in the email field and submit the reset request.
test_cases.expected_result: The system applies its defined email normalization behavior consistently; if case-insensitive matching and trimming are supported, it identifies the registered account and sends the reset link, otherwise the behavior is recorded for product clarification.
